extra.message: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI). The user-controlled 'username' query parameter (defined on the '/' endpoint at line 8) is concatenated directly into a Jinja2 template string passed to Jinja2.from_string(...).render(). Because user input becomes part of the template source rather than a rendered variable, an attacker can supply Jinja2 expressions (e.g. ?username={{7*7}} or ?username={{config.__class__.__init__.__globals__['os'].popen('id').read()}}) to read sensitive data and achieve remote code execution. The safe parameterized form is commented out on line 17.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
